AN ORDINANCE TO PROVIDE FOR THE USE AND OPERATION OF THE CLAY E. GALLEY PARK, THE CLERMONT GYM PARK AND THE G.T. KESLER BALLFIELD; TO PROVIDE FOR HOURS OF OPERATION; TO REQUIRE THAT MEMBERS OF THE GENERAL PUBLIC LEAVE SAID PARK UPON REQUEST OR DIRECTION BY AN AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVE OF THE TOWN COUNCIL; TO PROHIBIT ANY PERSON FROM DEFACING OR VANDALIZING ANY REAL OR PERSONAL PROPERTY, OR BOTH, OF THE PARKS; TO PROVIDE A SPEED LIMIT FOR THE OPERATION OF ANY VEHICLES WITHIN THE PARKS, TO PROHIBIT HUNTING OR TRAPPING OF ANY WILDLIFE IN THE PARKS WITHOUT THE PRIOR WRITTEN PERMISSION OF THE TOWN COUNCIL; TO PROHIBIT ANY INTOXICATED PERSON FROM ENTERING OR REMAINING WITHIN THE PARKS; TO PROHIBIT ANY PERSON FROM CONSUMING OR USING ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES OR INTOXICANTS WITHIN THE PARKS; TO PROHIBIT THE USE OF ANY ELECTRONIC DEVICE FOR THE DETECTION OF METALS, MINERALS, ARTIFACTS, OR LOST ARTICLES OR FOR TREASURE HUNTING BY ANY PERSON WITHIN THE PARKS; TO PROHIBIT ANY PERSON FROM USING OR POSSESSING IN THE PARKS ANY FIREWORKS, EXPLOSIVES, OR | FIRECRACKERS, UNLESS SUCH USE HAS BEEN APPROVED BY PRIOR WRITTEN PERMISSION OF THE TOWN COUNCIL; TO PROHIBIT THE USE, POSSESSION, OR DISCHARGE WITHIN THE PARKS ANY BOWS AND ARROWS, SPRING GUNS, AIR RIFLES, SLING SHOTS, OR ANY OTHER DEVICE WHICH DISCHARGES PROJECTILES BY ANY MEANS, WITHOUT THE PRIOR WRITTEN PERMISSION OF THE TOWN COUNCIL; TO PROHIBIT THE USE OF FIREARMS WITHIN THE PARKS BY LAW; TO PROHIBIT THE USE OR DISCHARGE BY ANY PERSON OF ANY BOW AND ARROW, SPRING GUN, AIR RIFLE, SLING SHOTS, OR OTHER DEVICE WHICH DISCHARGES PROJECTILES BY ANY MEANS, INTO THE PARKS FROM BEYOND THE BOUNDARIES OF SAID PARKS; TO PROHIBIT THE DISCHARGE OF ANY FIREARM BY ANY PERSON INTO THE PARKS FROM BEYOND THE BOUNDARIES OF SAID PARKS; TO PROVIDE FOR PENALTIES FOR ANY VIOLATION OF THIS ORDINANCE; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

BE IT ORDAINED by the Town Council of Clermont, Georgia, and it is hereby ordained by authority of the Town Charter, as amended, and Article IX, Section I, Paragraph II of the Georgia Constitution of 1983, as amended, and O.C.G.A. § 36-35-3, as amended:
3: This ordinance shall be titled and know as, “the Clermont Parks Ordinance”.
4: The Clermont Parks shall be public parks open to any member of the general public for recreational uses including all intellectual, creative, social or educational interest as allowed by Georgia law. The parks may be used for special events by public interest groups, if the events will not cause a danger to the public safety, upon special written permission granted by the Town Council of Clermont, The Town Council is authorized to adopt and promulgate all rules and regulations relating to the use and operation of the parks.
5:
(A) The hours of operation of the Clay E. Gailey Park which will allow the use and enjoyment of said park by any person shall be as follows: Beginning May 1st of each year and until October 31st of each year, the hours of operation of this park shall be between 9:00 A.M. Eastern Standard Time or Eastern Daylight Time, whichever is applicable and 10:00 P.M., eastern Standard Time or Eastern Daylight Time, whichever is applicable;

Beginning November 1st of each year and until April 30th of each year, the hours of operation of this park shall be between 9:00 A.M. Eastern Standard Time or Eastern Daylight Time, whichever is applicable, and 7:00 P.M. Eastern Standard Time or Eastern Daylight Time, whichever is applicable.

(B) The hours of operation of the Clermont Gym Park which will allow the use and enjoyment of said park by any person shall be as follows: Beginning January 1st of each year and until December 31st of each year, the hours of operation for this park shall be between 8:00 A.M. Eastern Standard Time or Eastern Daylight Time, whichever is applicable, and Dark, Eastern

Standard Time or Eastern Daylight Time, whichever is applicable, Mondays through Saturdays,

and between 1:00 P.M., Eastern Standard Time or Eastern Daylight Time, whichever is applicable, and 6:00 P.M., Eastern Standard Time or Eastern Daylight Time, whichever is applicable, on Sundays. The hours stated above pertain to the baseball field only.

(C) The hours of operation of the G. T. Kesler Ballfield which will allow the use and enjoyment of said park by any person shall be as follows: Beginning January 1st of each year and until December 31st of each year, the hours of operation of this park shall be between 8:00 AM., Eastern Standard Time or Eastern Daylight Time, whichever is applicable, and Dark, Eastern Standard Time or Eastern Daylight Time, whichever is applicable.

(D) Any use or entry onto the premises of the Clermont Parks at a time other than the hours of operation of the Clermont Parks shall be a violation of this ordinance. No person shall have the legal authority, right, or privilege to remain upon the premises of the Clermont Parks at a time other than the approved hours of operation of the Clermont Parks or remain after receiving a direction to leave by an authorized representative of the Town Council.
6: It shall be prohibited for any person, in any manner, to vandalize, to mark on, deface, injure, displace, dig, excavate, remove, or construct on any real or personal property within the Clermont Parks, except when done with special written permission granted by the Town Council.
7: It shall be prohibited for any person to drive a vehicle on any road in the Clermont Parks and recreational area in excess of 5 m.p.h. As used in this section, the term “vehicle” means any wheeled conveyance for the transportation of persons or materials.
8:
It shall be prohibited to hunt, trap, or otherwise pursue or catch any wildlife in the Clermont Parks, unless such activity has been approved by prior written permission of the Town

Council and is allowed by Georgia law.
10: It shall be prohibited for any intoxicated person to enter or remain on the premises of the Clermont Parks. It shall also be prohibited for any person to consume or use alcoholic beverages or intoxicants on the premises of the Clermont Parks.
11: It shall be prohibited for any person to use in the Clermont Parks any electronic device for the detection of metal, minerals, artifacts, or lost articles, or for treasure hunting, unless such activity has been approved by prior written permission of the Town Council.
12: It shall be prohibited for any person to use or possess in the Clermont Parks any fireworks, explosives, or firecrackers, unless such use has been approved by prior written permission of the Town Council.
13: It shall be prohibited for any person to use or possess in the Clermont Parks any bows and arrows, spring guns, air rifles, sling shots, or any other device which discharges projectiles by any means, unless such use has been approved within restricted areas by the prior written permission of the Town Council. Firearms are prohibited by law.
15: It shall be prohibited for any person to shoot into the Clermont Parks by way of any bow and arrow, spring gun, air rifle, sling shot, or any other device which discharges projectiles by any means, from beyond the boundaries of the Clermont Parks. Firearms are prohibited by law.
16:
Any person who violates any section of this ordinance may be directed to leave the Clermont Parks by the Town Council or any authorized representative of the Town Council. No person shall have legal authority, right, or privilege to remain within the Clermont Parks after

receiving such a direction. It shall be prohibited to refuse to leave the Clermont Parks after violating any section of this ordinance and after being directed to leave by the Town Council or an authorized representative of the Town Council.
17: Any person who shall do anything prohibited by this ordinance as the same exists, or as it may hereafter be amended, or who shall fail to do anything required by this ordinance as the same exists, or as it my hereafter be amended, besides being required to leave the premises of the Clermont Parks, shall be subject to the penalties allowed by the Uniform Penalty Ordinance, and as assessed in the discretion of the Judge of the Municipal Court of Clermont.
18: If any paragraph, sub-paragraph, sentence, clause, phrase, or any portion of this ordinance, should be declared invalid or unconstitutional by any Court of competent jurisdiction or if the provisions of any part of this ordinance as applied to any particular situation or set of circumstances should be declared invalid or unconstitutional, such invalidity shall not be construed to affect the portions of this ordinance not so held to be invalid, or the application of this ordinance to other circumstances not so held to be invalid. It is hereby declared by the intent of the Town Council of the Town of Clermont to provide for separate and divisible parts, and it does hereby adopt any and all parts hereof as may not be held invalid for any reason.
19:
All ordinances and parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby repealed.
